### Summary of Stages in Final Solver

The complete pipeline in [solution.cpp](file:///workspace/benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp) operates in six coordinated stages:

1. Redundancy Stripping: Extracts unique maximal strings by filtering out strict substrings.
2. Fast Trie Engine: Maintains exact toroidal substring matches across all 800 positions in O(1) time per single-cell mutation.
3. Bidirectional Randomized Greedy Superstring Merging: Merges maximal strings into rows and columns across multiple randomized restarts.
4. 4-Way Torus Invariant Simulated Annealing: Performs cyclic row shifts, row swaps, col shifts, and col swaps, preserving horizontal superstring integrity while searching for vertical intersections.
5. Progressive 2D Non-Destructive Placement: Injects remaining unmatched reads into low-conflict positions when net score strictly increases.
6. Dot Filling and Coordinate Descent: Fills remaining blank cells and quenches the 400 cells to guaranteed local optimality.
7. Multi-Candidate Large Neighborhood Search: Randomly selects unplaced reads, identifies top partial matching positions, injects full strings, repairs adjacent orthogonal cells, and accepts improvements or rolls back using an exact undo stack.
